αἰνὸν: αἰνός — dread, fearsome, grim; neut. nom./acc. sg. (αἰνὸν ἄχος ’fearsome grief’)
αὐλείῃσι: αὔλειος — of the courtyard, belonging to the αὐλή; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), with θύρῃσι: ’courtyard doors’
γήμασθ: γαμέω — marry; aor. inf. mid., elided (γήμασθ’ = γήμασθαι), of a woman, used as an imperative: ’marry!’
δέξασθ: δέχομαι — receive, accept; aor. inf. mid., elided (δέξασθ’ = δέξασθαι), used as an imperative: ’accept!’ (not a plural δέξασθε)
δαινύατ: δαίνυμαι — feast, dine; opt. 3 pl. mid., elided (δαινύατ’ = δαινύατο, epic for δαινυίατο): ’they would feast’ (with κε)
δεδμημένοι: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue, tame; perf. part. pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’overpowered’
διογενῆς: διογενής — Zeus-born, sprung from Zeus; masc. nom. sg., stock epithet of Odysseus
εἴρια: εἴριον (εἶρος) — wool, fleece; neut. acc. pl.
εὐρυδάμαντι: Εὐρυδάμας — Eurydamas, one of the suitors; masc. dat. sg.
κάγκανα: κάγκανος — dry, parched; neut. acc. pl., with ξύλα: ’dry (logs)’
καρπῷ: καρπός — wrist; masc. dat. sg. (distinct from καρπός ’fruit’)
κεκεασμένα: κεάζω — split, cleave; perf. part. pass. neut. acc. pl. (κεκεασμένα, epic form): ’split’
κραδίην: κραδίη — heart (epic = Attic καρδία); fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ην
λαμπτῆρας: λαμπτήρ — brazier, a stand holding a fire for light; masc. acc. pl.
λελῦτο: λύω — loose, loosen; perf. opt. 3 sg. pass. (usual view), in a wish continued from νεύοιεν: ’may (the limbs) be loosened’
λιποῦσα: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’leaving’; with κατά in tmesis (κατὰ … λιποῦσα = καταλιποῦσα)
λώβη: λώβη — outrage, shameful abuse, disgrace; fem. nom. sg.
μέγεθος: μέγεθος — size, stature; neut. acc. sg., after the preposition ἐς: ’to stature’
μαχητὰς: μαχητής — fighter, warrior; masc. acc. pl.
μεθύοντι: μεθύω — be drunk; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., with ἐοικώς: ’like one drunk’
μετέμισγον: μεταμίσγω — mix in among, mingle with; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented: ’they mixed in’
μνηστεύειν: μνηστεύω — woo, court; pres. inf. act.
μορόεντα: μορόεις — of uncertain sense, perhaps ’mulberry-like’ (μόρον ’mulberry’); neut. acc. pl.
μῶλος: μῶλος — toil of battle, struggle, strife; masc. nom. sg.
νεύοιεν: νεύω — nod, bow the head; pres. opt. 3 pl., in a wish after αἲ γάρ: ’may they nod’
νικήσουσι: νικάω — conquer, overcome, outlast; fut. 3 pl. act.: ’they will overcome’
πάθοι: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were to suffer’
πέλοιτο: πέλομαι (πέλω) — be, become, come to be; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., with κε: ’would come to be’
παρέλκετο: παρέλκω — draw aside, draw out for oneself; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’she was drawing out’
πείκετε: πείκω — comb, card (wool); pres. imper. 2 pl. act.
πεισάνδροιο: Πείσανδρος — Peisander, a suitor, son of Polyctor; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
περίεσσι: περίειμι — be superior to, surpass (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg., epic ἐσσί (= Attic περίει)
περόναι: περόνη — pin, brooch for fastening a robe; fem. nom. pl.
πλέονές: πλείων (πλέων) — more; comparative of πολύς, masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted πλέονες (= Attic πλείους), accented before enclitic κε
πλήσσουσι: πλήσσω — strike; pres. 3 pl. act.; with ἐκ in tmesis (ἐκ … πλήσσουσι = ἐκπλήσσουσι): ’strike out of one’s wits, daunt’
πολυκτορίδαο: Πολυκτορίδης — son of Polyctor; masc. gen. sg., patronymic, epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
πολυτλήμων: πολυτλήμων — much-enduring, very patient; masc. nom. sg., predicate (πολύ + root of τλῆναι ’endure’)
στροφαλίζετε: στροφαλίζω — twirl, spin (thread); pres. imper. 2 pl. act.
τέρπετε: τέρπω — delight, please; pres. imper. 2 pl. act.
τρίγληνα: τρίγληνος — three-eyed, with three pendants or drops (sense uncertain); neut. acc. pl.
τρῶάς: Τρώς — Trojan; masc. acc. pl., accusative subject of ἔμμεναι (Attic Τρῶας)
τὼς: τώς — thus, so; epic adv. (= Attic οὕτως)
φέρτερος: φέρτερος — stronger, better; comparative of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. sg., predicate
φαίη: φημί — say, assert; pres. opt. 3 sg., with κέν: ’might say’
φαείνοιεν: φαείνω — give light, shine (epic by-form of φαίνω); pres. opt. 3 pl., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’might give light’
χέρεια: χερείων (χέρης) — worse, inferior; comparative of κακός, neut. nom./acc. pl. (τὰ χέρεια ’the worse things’)
ἀεικισθήμεναι: ἀεικίζω — treat unseemly, maltreat; aor. inf. pass., epic -θήμεναι (= Attic ἀεικισθῆναι): ’to be maltreated’
ἀμοιβηδὶς: ἀμοιβηδίς — in turn, by turns; adv.
ἀμφιπολεύοι: ἀμφιπολεύω — attend, tend, look after; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were to tend’
ἀνέβαιν: ἀναβαίνω — go up, mount; impf. 3 sg., elided and augmented (ἀνέβαιν’ = ἀνέβαινε): ’went up’
ἀνέσει: ἀνίημι — let go, release; fut. 3 sg. act., or short-vowel subj. with κε (the sense is the same): ’will let go’
ἀνέφαινον: ἀναφαίνω — make appear, cause to blaze up; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented: ’they made blaze’
ἀντιβολήσει: ἀντιβολέω — meet, encounter (+ gen.); fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will meet’
ἀντινόῳ: Ἀντίνοος — Antinous, son of Eupeithes, a leading suitor; masc. dat. sg.
ἀπάγουσι: ἀπάγω — lead away, carry off, bring; pres. 3 pl. act.: ’they bring’
ἀπελάμπετο: ἀπολάμπω — shine forth, gleam; impf. 3 sg. mid. with active sense, augmented: ’shone forth’
ἀρ: ἄρα — then, so; inferential particle, short form ἀρ’ (= ἄρα, elided before a vowel)
ἀρωγοί: ἀρωγός — helper, helping; masc. nom. pl., as a noun: ’helpers’
ἁλώω: ἁλίσκομαι — be taken, be captured; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic lengthened vowel (= Attic ἁλῶ): ’I may be taken’
ἄχομαι: ἄχομαι (ἄχνυμαι) — be grieved, sorrow, from ἄχος; pres. 1 sg. mid.: ’I grieve’
ἐερμένον: εἴρω — string, fasten in a row; perf. part. pass. masc. acc. sg. (ἐερμένον, reduplicated), agreeing with ὅρμον: ’strung’
ἐθέλωσιν: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 pl., ν-movable: ’they may wish’ (after ἤν = ἐάν)
ἐνεῖκαι: φέρω — bring, carry; aor. inf. act., epic -αι (= Attic ἐνεγκεῖν): ’to bring’
ἐνώμας: ἐνωμάω — handle, turn over, ply; impf. 2 sg. act., contracted: ’you used to turn over’
ἐπέσσευεν: ἐπισεύω — drive on, hurl upon; aor. 3 sg. act., epic form with doubled σ (aor. ἔσσευα of σεύω): ’drove upon’
ἐπιβήτορας: ἐπιβήτωρ — one who mounts, rider; masc. acc. pl.
ἐρίσωσιν: ἐρίζω — contend, strive; aor. subj. 3 pl. act., in a general relative clause: ’such as contend’
ἐϋγνάμπτοις: ἐΰγναμπτος — well-bent; adj., dat. pl., agreeing with κληῗσιν: ’well-bent (hooks)’
ἐϋκνήμιδας: ἐΰκνημις — well-greaved, with good greaves; masc. acc. pl., standing epithet of the Achaeans
ἔασας: ἐάω — allow, permit; aor. 2 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἴασας): ’you allowed’
ἔκριναν: κρίνω — decide, judge, separate; aor. 3 pl. act., augmented; with κε in a general relative clause: ’who would decide’
ἔμπεδοι: ἔμπεδος — firm, steady, abiding; masc./fem. nom. pl., predicate: ’firm’
ἔφερον: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented: ’they carried’ · also impf. 1 sg. (same form)
ἕρματα: ἕρμα — earring, pendant (also ’prop, support’); neut. acc. pl. ἕρματα
ἤνεικεν: φέρω — bring, carry; aor. 3 sg. act., epic ἤνεικε(ν) (= Attic ἤνεγκε); with ἐκ in tmesis (ἐκ … ἤνεικεν): ’brought out’
ἴασον: Ἴασος — Iasian; obscure epithet of Ἄργος (meaning not certain); neut. acc. sg.
ἴδοιεν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. opt. 3 pl. act., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were to see’
ἴρου: Ἶρος — Irus, the town beggar; masc. gen. sg.
ἴσθμιον: ἴσθμιον — neck-band, necklace (from ἰσθμός ’neck’); neut. acc. sg.
ὀλβίου: ὄλβιος — prosperous, blessed, fortunate; masc. gen. sg.
ὀρθὸς: ὀρθός — upright, straight; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’upright’
ὁμοιΐου: ὁμοίϊος (= ὅμοιος) — impartial, common to both sides (sense disputed); masc. gen. sg., with πολέμοιο
ὅπη: ὅπῃ — where, in what direction; relative adv. (ὅπῃ οἱ νόστος ’where his homecoming lies’)
ὠκυπόδων: ὠκύπους — swift-footed; masc. gen. pl., epithet of horses
ᾖε: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾔει): ’went’
ᾖεν: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic ᾖεν, ν-movable (= Attic ᾔει): ’went’
ῥυστακτύος: ῥυστακτύς — rough handling, being dragged about (sense inferred from ῥυστάζω ’pull about’; rare); fem. gen. sg.
ῥυτῆρας: ῥυτήρ — one who draws, drawer (of a bow), archer; masc. acc. pl.

__broaden__.γυναικῶν: γυνή — woman; fem. gen. pl., partitive with δῖα: ’heavenly-one of women’ · also partitive with ἀρίστη: ’best of women’ · also possessive gen. with a noun: ἔργα γυναικῶν ’the works of women’ · also gen. after a verb of surpassing, ’above, beyond women’ (περίεσσι γυναικῶν)
__broaden__.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’) · also + subj. in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to’ (οἵ κε … ἀγγείλωσι ’who are to announce’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a main clause: ’will’ (αἶψά κε … ἀποτίσεται ’at once he will exact payment’) · also + aor. in a general relative clause: ’who would (decide)’ (οἵ κε … ἔκριναν)
__broaden__.μίμνειν: μίμνω (= μένω) — stay, remain; pres. inf., epic (= Attic μένειν) · also transitive, ’wait for’ + acc. (Ἠῶ μίμνειν ’to wait for Dawn’)
__broaden__.τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’, object of the verb in its clause (ῥωγαλέα, τὰ … ὅρηαι ’torn, which you see’) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective, neut.: ’the (worse things)’ (τὰ χέρεια)
__broaden__.τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’) · also article-like before the adverb πάρος: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also article-like before an ordinal, adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time’ · also distributive, neut. nom./acc. sg.: τὸ μὲν … τὸ δὲ ’one thing … another’ · also article-like before the adverb πρόσθεν: ’formerly’ (τὸ πρόσθεν ὄλοντο ’died long before’) · also article-like before a substantivized adjective, neut.: τὸ μέλαν ’the dark (part)’ · also article-like before the adverb πάροιθε: ’formerly’ (τὸ πάροιθε ’in former times’)
__broaden__.βίῃ: βίη — strength, force; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’by force’ · also dat. sg. with εἴκων, the thing yielded to: ’yielding to force’ (βίῃ καὶ κάρτεϊ εἴκων) · also dat. of respect, ’in strength’ (βίῃ φέρτερος ’stronger in strength’)
__broaden__.θέλγε: θέλγω — charm, enchant, beguile; pres. imper. 2 sg. · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθελγε): ’she enchanted’
__broaden__.ἐθέλωσι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 pl., in a conditional clause with κε: ’are willing’ · also pres. subj. 3 pl., in a general relative clause without κε: ’who are willing’ (οἵ τ’ … μνηστεύειν ἐθέλωσι)
__broaden__.χρύσεον: χρύσεος — golden; adj., neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῦν) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὅρμον: ’golden’ (ὅρμον … χρύσεον)
__broaden__.κληῗσιν: κληΐς — thwart, rowing-bench (also thole-pin, key, bar); fem. dat. pl., epic -σιν (the diaeresis marks the two syllables) · also hook, clasp of a brooch: ’hooks’ (κληῗσιν ἐϋγνάμπτοις ’well-bent hooks’)
__broaden__.δέμας: δέμας — bodily form, frame; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in body’ · also neut. acc. sg., direct object or in apposition: ’body’ (εἶδός τε δέμας τε ’form and body’)
__broaden__.νεμεσσῶμαι: νεμεσσάομαι — be indignant at, disapprove of; pres. 1 sg. mid., contracted, epic doubled σ (= Attic νεμεσῶμαι), + dat. · also + acc. of the person and an infinitive: ’resent (you) for …’ (οὔ σε νεμεσσῶμαι κεχολῶσθαι)
__broaden__.νοῆσαι: νοέω — perceive, notice, take note of; aor. inf.: ’to glimpse, to notice’ · also ’think out, think of’ (πεπνυμένα πάντα νοῆσαι ’to think of all prudent things’)
__broaden__.πάροιθε: πάροιθε — in front, before; adv. of place · also of time: ’formerly, before’ (τὸ πάροιθε)
